Consider the following C structure: struct Node { int data; struct Node *next; }; What is the purpose of the struct Node *next member in the Node structure

options.A: To store the data of the next node
options.B: To store the address of the previous node

sq.q: Explain how structures are used in C programming to organize and manage related data. Illustrate your explanation with an example that involves defining a structure, initializing it, and accessing its members
answer: You can initialize a structure when you declare a variable of that structure type.

Direct Access: Use the dot operator to access members of a structure.
